_comment: Each mutant is applied to a COPY of scripts/checks/cache-headers-probe.mjs (and scripts/checks/lib/*.mjs) under .tmp/sandbox/; `node <copy> --selftest` must then exit NONZERO. 'find' is a regex over the probe source; the dev may adjust the pattern to the final code but must keep the intent and keep every mutant killed. A mutant that survives is a missing selftest vector.

mutants.intent: restore the silent status mismatch: status mismatch prints no FAIL line (the original `status && report` form)
FAIL line drops the observed status (no status=<n>)
mismatch no longer counted: probeRoute returns true on a status mismatch
title check passes when <title> is missing
title check asserts in testing mode too (would fail today)
anchor check accepts href=#ticket-wosa as the anchor
payments mode reader defaults to live when the constant is unparseable
mutants.kill: selftest asserts unparseable source throws / exit 2
